events.title: WorldSkills Opening Ceremony
events.introduction: The grand opening ceremony of WorldSkills 2022 Special Edition was held in various host regions simultaneously, celebrating the skills of young people from around the world.

events.title: Wildlife & Nature
events.introduction: Discover the beauty of wildlife around the world, from majestic tigers swimming through rivers to curious cats exploring their surroundings in the warm afternoon sun.

events.title: Flowers & Gardens
events.introduction: A breathtaking collection of nature's finest blooms, featuring vibrant lotus flowers and golden sunflower fields stretching endlessly under bright blue skies.

events.title: Landscapes & Scenery
events.introduction: Stunning landscapes from around the globe — serene lake reflections at dusk, golden mountain sunsets, and peaceful ocean views that take your breath away.
